facts.text: Sullust was a terrestrial planet that occupied the fourth orbit from the star Sullust in the Sullust system in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories region of the galaxy.

evidence.quote: Sullust was a terrestrial planet that occupied the fourth orbit from the star Sullust in the Sullust system in the Brema sector of the Outer Rim Territories region of the galaxy.

facts.text: Situated on the Rimma Trade Route and within the area known as the Trailing Sectors, Sullust had standard gravity and possessed two moons: a large planetoid named Sulon and an unremarkable hunk of rock named Umnub.

evidence.quote: Situated on the Rimma Trade Route and within the area known as the Trailing Sectors, Sullust had standard gravity and possessed two moons: a large planetoid named Sulon and an unremarkable hunk of rock named Umnub.

facts.text: The planet was 12,780 kilometers in diameter and featured terrain including mountains, volcanoes, rocky deserts, and caves; multicolored rock veined by channels of magma covered Sullust's entire surface.

evidence.quote: The planet was 12,780 kilometers in diameter and featured terrain including mountains, volcanoes, rocky deserts, and caves; multicolored rock veined by channels of magma covered Sullust's entire surface.

facts.text: The atmosphere of Sullust was barely breathable, with hot and thick clouds of toxic gases released in volcanic eruptions rendering the planet's surface lethal for sustained habitation and uncomfortable for short visits.

evidence.quote: The atmosphere of Sullust was barely breathable, with hot and thick clouds of toxic gases released in volcanic eruptions rendering the planet's surface lethal for sustained habitation and uncomfortable for short visits.

facts.text: Its surface was also dangerously volatile; while Sullust's geology was poorly understood, the mantle between the planet's core and its thick crust appeared to be semipermeable, allowing eruptions to occur frequently.

evidence.quote: Its surface was also dangerously volatile; while Sullust's geology was poorly understood, the mantle between the planet's core and its thick crust appeared to be semipermeable, allowing eruptions to occur frequently.

facts.text: Most of the opaque substances ejected by the volcanoes remained in the upper atmosphere while heavier gases flowed back down, resulting in high surface visibility and noxious surface air.

evidence.quote: Most of the opaque substances ejected by the volcanoes remained in the upper atmosphere while heavier gases flowed back down, resulting in high surface visibility and noxious surface air.

facts.text: Sullust was popularly known as "the volcano planet," but only certain portions of the world contained active volcanoes.

evidence.quote: Sullust was popularly known as "the volcano planet," but only certain portions of the world contained active volcanoes.

facts.text: Few of the volcanoes were reliably extinct, however.

evidence.quote: Few of the volcanoes were reliably extinct, however.

facts.text: A hub of trade along the Rimma Trade Route, Sullust had a corporate system of government and exported starships, computers, droids, hyperdrive technology, and astrogation technology while importing foodstuffs and water.

evidence.quote: A hub of trade along the Rimma Trade Route, Sullust had a corporate system of government and exported starships, computers, droids, hyperdrive technology, and astrogation technology while importing foodstuffs and water.

facts.text: During the reign of the Galactic Empire there were many bases built on the planet, and several major cities were locked down by Imperials.

evidence.quote: During the reign of the Galactic Empire there were many bases built on the planet, and several major cities were locked down by Imperials.

facts.text: The planet joined the Galactic Republic when Sullustan merchants connected their planet to Tapani sector with the Rimma Trade Route in 5500 BBY.

evidence.quote: The planet joined the Galactic Republic when Sullustan merchants connected their planet to Tapani sector with the Rimma Trade Route in 5500 BBY.

facts.text: The SoroSuub Corporation was already a part of Sullust's economy and government when the planet first gained access to interstellar travel, and over time, SoroSuub aided Sullust's government while becoming increasingly influential in the diplomacy of Sullust.

evidence.quote: The SoroSuub Corporation was already a part of Sullust's economy and government when the planet first gained access to interstellar travel, and over time, SoroSuub aided Sullust's government while becoming increasingly influential in the diplomacy of Sullust.

facts.text: It was attacked by the Krath during the Great Sith War, but was successfully defended by the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: It was attacked by the Krath during the Great Sith War, but was successfully defended by the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: The world was volatile with hundreds of active volcanoes, producing a noxious, toxic atmosphere and intense electrical storms.

evidence.quote: The world was volatile with hundreds of active volcanoes, producing a noxious, toxic atmosphere and intense electrical storms.

facts.text: These conditions, combined with the planet's rich mineral deposits, caused the native Sullustan inhabitants to live in underground caves.

evidence.quote: These conditions, combined with the planet's rich mineral deposits, caused the native Sullustan inhabitants to live in underground caves.

facts.text: The underground caves were humid and cool, with a diverse biosphere supported by underground lakes.

evidence.quote: The underground caves were humid and cool, with a diverse biosphere supported by underground lakes.

facts.text: Nearly one-half of the population was under its employment.
